'''The Sword of Kirukan''' is an ancient blade attributed to the legendary warrior queen [[Kirukan]] of [[Aramaelle]].

==Description==
It is has a two-handed hilt and ornately sheathed in jeweled scabbard and is possibly [[power-wrought]]. It belongs to the Queen of [[Kandor]], and is borne for her by her [[Swordbearer]].
